description: Stage Route Model hardware profile. Stage partitions and workloads are generated online from transformed TTIR; this file contains no workload-specific Stage template or route multiplier.

selection_calibration.description: The only structural threshold consumed by the Stage partitioner. Numerical Stage costs come from mode-specific resource formulas and referenced measurements; obsolete route penalties and multipliers have been removed.
selection_calibration.source: StagePartitioner uses this architecture-independent boundary to select the tiny-dot formula family. It is a semantic model-domain limit, not a fitted route multiplier.

simd.description: Inputs used to estimate the all-SIMD candidate: SIMD width, setup, operation, memory, and dot costs.

startup_system_cycles.description: One-time SIMD Stage startup proxy measured with a compile-time-specialized minimal observable vector body and matching barrier-only subtraction.
startup_system_cycles.note: The consumed vector value is measured; memory-transfer startup is modeled per logical memory operation.

f32.add.description: Measured FP32 SIMD add base throughput resolved from the shared microbenchmark profile.

f32.exp.description: Measured effective FP32 SIMD exponential throughput.

f32.log.description: Measured effective FP32 SIMD logarithm throughput.

predicate.cmp.description: Measured standalone semantic SIMD comparison throughput.

convert.cast.description: Measured effective SIMD cast throughput per semantic cast.

f32.clamp.description: Measured effective SIMD throughput per semantic clamp.

memory.description: Model-specific all-SIMD memory rates consumed by StageCostModel.
memory.note: Each cost is startup per logical load/store operation plus bytes divided by the fitted asymptotic throughput.

dot.description: SIMD tiny-dot cost: dynamic matrix instances times setup plus aggregate FLOPs divided by dependent-chain throughput.
dot.source: Ascend950PR dependent N=16/N=32 dot-chain joint fit with one final store

stage_resources.description: Generic SIMD front-end inputs. Unclassified scalar and control instructions contribute only to the measured shared issue lower bound. Independent control latency is unsupported until a composite signature curve is identifiable. The measured loaded-index curve is restricted to FP16 shapes with matching byte and warp-instruction totals; unmatched indirect memory is unsupported.

prefix_scan.description: One SIMD sequence is an R-1 dependent vector-add chain; independent sequences are packed by vector width. The model uses this measured step latency separately from the aggregate add issue floor.

loop_carried_recurrence.description: Measured lower bound for one physical group's iteration of a reduction recurrence. The work-size key is reduction lane-steps per logical program; SIMD has only factor 1.

continuous_memory.description: Measured physical-group execution envelope for ordinary contiguous FP32 transfers. Curves are consumed only inside the measured byte interval; operation count is multiplied once and route composition multiplies runtime waves once.

stage_resources.source: Ascend950PR versioned microbenchmark evidence. The issue floor is an observable conservative bound, not a claimed microarchitecture peak. Control instructions enter that shared floor but do not receive fabricated additive latency. Loaded-index loads use the measured operation-shape curve; unmatched indirect accesses are unsupported.

simt.description: Inputs used to estimate the all-SIMT candidate and the SIMT portion of a mixed candidate.

setup_system_cycles.description: Completion-inclusive minimal-SIMT-VF net setup selected by launched warp count. All entries use compile-time-specialized binaries and subtract the matching barrier-only loop.

f32.add.description: Measured FP32 SIMT scalar-add base throughput resolved from the shared microbenchmark profile.

f32.exp.description: Measured effective FP32 SIMT exponential throughput.

f32.log.description: Measured effective FP32 SIMT logarithm throughput.

predicate.cmp.description: Measured standalone semantic SIMT comparison throughput.

convert.cast.description: Measured effective SIMT cast throughput per semantic cast.

f32.clamp.description: Measured effective SIMT throughput per semantic clamp.

dot.description: SIMT tiny-dot cost: dynamic matrix instances times setup plus aggregate FLOPs divided by dependent-chain throughput.
dot.source: Ascend950PR dependent N=16/N=32 dot-chain joint fit with one final store

shuffle.description: SIMT workload-effective shuffle rate resolved from the shared runtime-loop microbenchmark. Route-level generalization confidence is intentionally lower than measurement repeatability.

memory.description: SIMT workload-effective GM load/store rates resolved from sequential rotating runtime-loop measurements. Indirect/random/coalescing behavior is not calibrated by these rates.

stage_resources.description: Generic SIMT front-end inputs. Unclassified scalar and control instructions contribute only to the measured shared issue lower bound. Prefix-scan issue accounting preserves one shuffle, predicate and add instruction per sequence and level. Independent control latency is unsupported until a composite signature curve is identifiable. The measured loaded-index curve is restricted to FP16 shapes with matching byte and warp-instruction totals; unmatched indirect memory is unsupported.

prefix_scan.description: One SIMT sequence is a ceil(log2(R)) dependent shuffle/add/control chain. Independent sequences add an aggregate issue floor but do not lengthen this critical path.

loop_carried_recurrence.description: Measured lower bound for one physical SuperBlock group's iteration of a reduction recurrence. Each inner work-size key is reduction lane-steps in one logical program; the measured value already includes all F logical programs in the physical group.

continuous_memory.description: Measured physical-group execution envelope for ordinary contiguous FP32 transfers. Each factor-specific value already includes all logical programs grouped by that SuperBlock factor; the Stage formula must not multiply it by F again.

layout_memory.description: 950PR strided-wide FP32 solve_tril layout model. The exact 16x16, row=64 B, row-stride=8192 B, masked layout is matched by the full key below. S6 uses one unified per-load L (first=incremental), so four loads are charged as 4*L; route scheduling supplies the logical-program iteration count. S22 keeps the measured store envelope L+(n-1)*II for the ten grouped stores. These entries are SIMT-only and factor-specific by active warp count.

strided_wide:r=2:row=64:stride=8192:rows.evidence: 950pr_simt_layout_memory_grouped_healthy_fit_20260918.json; unified no-first/steady S6 load fit from two fence=0 stride columns
950pr_simt_layout_memory_README.md; S6 confirmed definition C_S6=L*4*5 with L=145.772 ticks/load
950pr_simt_layout_memory_grouped_healthy_fit_20260918.json; unified no-first/steady S6 load fit from two fence=0 stride columns

950pr_simt_layout_memory_grouped_healthy_fit_20260918.json; fence=0 8-warp composite store envelope. Its measured L+(n-1)*II already includes the lowering/layout service seen in the generated store path; do not add LDS/STS/LDK/STK or barrier residuals a second time.

scope_handoff.description: One Stage materializes as one compound scope.scope; Mixed is illegal for a single Stage. The route formula is C_scope = C_body + C_boundary_data + C_fixed_scope, where C_boundary_data = F*B_in/R_in + F*B_out/R_out is charged to the selected Stage body and C_fixed_scope is the only per-physical-group scope handoff term. These uncalibrated fallbacks preserve the previous full-active-lane numerical result (668+668, 1/(1/256+1/128), 1/(1/128+1/512)) but do not claim independently measurable directional constants or per-thread UB bandwidth. Replace them with exact-lowering empty/input/output scope sweeps.

stage_resources.source: Ascend950PR versioned microbenchmark evidence. The issue floor is an observable conservative bound, not a claimed microarchitecture peak. Control instructions enter that shared floor but do not receive fabricated additive latency. Loaded-index loads use the measured operation-shape curve; scope hand-off retains explicitly marked fallback parameters.

store_footprint_service.evidence: 950pr_simt_layout_service_20260918.json reproduces the fit: 950PR device4, full sweep ew6SfU, 36 held-out layout/warp points, max slope error 5.216%. SYS_CNT, 64-bit/lane, hot GM. Online use restricted to nonpacked nonoverlapping rows: packed issue-floor transfer failed in grouped repeat Xw1NYC. Service estimate only, not first-round, barrier, private/shared, layout-conversion or complete Stage calibration.
